products.product_description: Zesty Sweet Peppers. Shelf stable product in glass container. Net wt. 8 oz (372 g). The label is read in parts: "***Zesty Sweet Peppers *** Ingredients: Sweet Peppers, Balsamic Vinegar (organic wine vinegar, organic concentrated grape must), Olive Oil, Onion, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Rosemary, Thyme *** Batch** Date Processed *** SOUL CEDAR FARM 124 Center Rd. Chimacum, WA 98325 ***".
products.code_info: Process dates: 5/27/2021 (code ZP05211), 9/13/2021 (ZP09212), 10/8/2021 (ZP10213), 2/5/2022 (ZP02221), and 2/14/2022 (ZP02222). Code Interpretation of ZP02221: ZP is the product (Zest Peppers), 02 is the month (February), 22 is the year (2022), and 1 is the batch number (first batch during 2022).
products.reason_for_recall: Potential to be contaminated with Clostridium botulinum. Product was tested and found to have pH level of 5.57.
